name: slicer-bomb-matched-40960-v1
declared: 2026-11-01 before any extended default-trained or PPO/SB3 model was trained
scope: Follow-up on three previously observed synthetic bomb-heavy settings; no fresh holdout or hyperparameter tuning.
reused_rows: Use the 15 previously committed 40,960-step in-setting scratch DQN rows byte-identically; train 65 additional agent/setting/seed jobs.
eval_policy: greedy/argmax on the same deterministic 30 episodes per seed as the earlier difficulty evaluation
comparisons: At 40,960 steps, compare each default-trained agent with its in-setting reference on each of the three settings. Report group means, seed-level bootstrap 95% intervals and in-setting-minus-default gaps for fruit and return, using the existing 2,000-resample independent-group gap_ci. Report bomb hits alongside each. All twelve agent-setting cells are reported.
reproduction_gate: Before interpreting 40,960-step values, compare each new 20,480-step checkpoint with the corresponding committed 20,480-step row for parameter fingerprint and all three metrics. The 15 reused DQN rows must already reproduce the old evidence. If any agent/setting/seed differs, report that failure and withhold a 40,960-step comparison for the affected agent.
reading_rules: The three settings were inspected in earlier runs; no new held-out generalization claim.
A 40,960-step gap is budget matched. Fruit-only advantage with more bomb hits must be qualified by return and bomb hits.
Five seeds and repeated evaluation episodes limit inference; confidence intervals do not prove equivalence.
No change to agents, environment, hyperparameters or policy selection after seeing results.
